You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 14 of 50 (script duration 87.6 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E4: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
E5: Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.
E6: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
E7: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
E8: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
E9: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
E10: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
E11: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
E12: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
E13: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
Direct lead-in to E14: Picks up immediately from Episode 13's cliffhanger where Juliana grasped the emerald ring beneath the razor-sharp blackthorns.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-5.6] SCREEN: Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.
[L002 0.5-5.5] ACTION: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
[L003 1.0-5.5] SFX: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
[L004 5.6-9.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.
[L005 7.7-9.0] JULIANA (Exhausted, Resolute): "I found it."
[L006 9.5-13.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.
[L007 10.5-12.7] JULIANA (Firm, Commanding): "Now release my husband."
[L008 12.5-13.5] ACTION: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
[L009 13.5-15.5] SCREEN: Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
[L010 14.2-15.4] SFX: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
[L011 14.5-15.6] ACTION: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
[L012 15.6-18.5] SCREEN: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.
[L013 16.8-18.0] ALEXANDER (Gasping, Urgent): "Juliana."
[L014 18.5-23.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
[L015 18.8-23.0] ACTION: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
[L016 23.0-25.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.
[L017 23.1-25.0] ALEXANDER (Trembling, Heartbroken): "What have they done to you?"
[L018 25.5-29.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.
[L019 26.5-28.5] JULIANA (Softly, Stifling Pain): "Nothing they didn't promise."
[L020 29.5-32.5] SCREEN: Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.
[L021 29.8-32.0] JULIANA (Faint, Pleading): "Take me home."
[L022 32.5-38.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot as Alexander effortlessly scoops Juliana into his arms, gathering her up against his chest.
[L023 33.2-37.0] ACTION: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.
[L024 35.8-38.5] ALEXANDER (Deep, Sorrowful): "You should never have had to bleed for me."
[L025 38.5-40.5] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.
[L026 40.5-43.5] SCREEN: Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.
[L027 40.5-43.5] SFX: Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
[L028 43.5-47.0] SCREEN: Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.
[L029 44.0-47.0] ACTION: Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
[L030 44.0-47.5] SFX: Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
[L031 47.0-50.5] SCREEN: Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.
[L032 47.2-49.8] ALEXANDER (Hoarse, Stricken): "You could have lost your hands."
[L033 50.5-55.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.
[L034 51.8-54.0] JULIANA (Whispered, Emotional): "But I didn't lose you."
[L035 55.5-58.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
[L036 58.5-60.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.
[L037 58.5-60.0] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Tender): "I'm sorry."
[L038 60.5-63.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.
[L039 60.5-62.5] JULIANA (Gentle, Reassuring): "You didn't hurt me."
[L040 63.5-66.0] SCREEN: Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.
[L041 66.0-70.5] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.
[L042 66.0-67.4] JULIANA (Loving, Earnest): "You have taken my place today."
[L043 67.5-69.8] JULIANA (Continuing): "And you are doing it better than me."
[L044 70.5-76.0] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
[L045 71.0-76.0] ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
[L046 76.0-83.5] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.
[L047 76.5-81.0] ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow): "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again."
[L048 81.2-83.5] ACTION: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
[L049 83.5-87.6] SCREEN: Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.
[L050 84.0-87.0] ACTION: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.
[L051 84.5-87.6] SFX: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "A Vow of Vengeance", "segments": [{"start_line": "L047", "end_line": "L051"}], "hook_line": "L047", "hook": "Alexander makes a dark, intense vow to protect his wife, signaling a shift to retaliation.", "hook_quote": "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.", "cliffhanger_line": "L051", "cliffhanger": "Alexander's hand clenches in a fist of vengeance, leaving the viewer anticipating his retaliation.", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "It transitions the story from victimhood to the hero's inevitable fight back.", "setup_needed": "None", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 8}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "A Vow of Vengeance": total duration 11.1 s is outside 20-60 s

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
